title: eBay fee defaults in where-to-sell-calculator: 13.6% FVF and tiered per-order fee (split from P025)
problem: ebay-fee-calculator, marketplace-fee-compare, where-to-sell-calculator and reverb-fee-calculator default to a 13.25% final value fee and a flat $0.30 per-order fee. eBay's selling-fees help page (https://www.ebay.com/help/selling/fees-credits-invoices/selling-fees?id=4822, fetched 2026-10-16) lists 13.6% of the total sale up to $7,500 plus 2.35% above it, and a per-order fee of $0.30 for orders of $10.00 or less and $0.40 above. This row covers only where-to-sell-calculator: calc.mjs, the ebay/reverb explainer pages, channel-parity tests.
evidence: eBay selling-fees page, fetched 2026-10-16 by a ventures run (no effective date shown on the page)

Probe 2026-10-16 (P025 split run): in ebay-fee-calculator, sed 13.25->13.6 over calc.mjs, *.html and README leaves 498 of 499 tests passing (only the 'documented defaults' test fails), because the explainer page tests do not pin the derived dollar figures. The pages' 'On the defaults ... leftover $X' prose therefore goes stale silently: recompute each from the engine, do not hand-edit.
change: Same change as P026 (rate 13.6, per-order 0.30/0.40, 2.35% band over $7,500), reusing P026's figures so the ventures agree. Recompute derived prose from the engine; do not hand-edit.
metric: grep -rl '13\.25' ventures/where-to-sell-calculator returns nothing and its suite passes
baseline: see P025 (76 files across four ventures)
result: grep -rn '13\.25' ventures/where-to-sell-calculator leaves none; suite 229/229 pass. Shipped as 13.6% + $0.40 per order (the model has one flat fee, so the <=$10 tier of $0.30 is not modelled). ebay-fee-calculator (P026) still defaults to 13.25, so the channel-parity test's message says so.
